bounds: Two finite PGlite cases: concurrent first writes of two distinct user secrets when the self-world is absent, and a write with an existing world carrying retained metadata. The actual SQL foreign key, unique world identity and SecretsService are exercised.
limitations: No claim for all database faults, cross-agent world-id collisions, process crash recovery, encryption correctness or same-key competing writes. Safety-only model; the SQL calls must return for test completion.
